title: Client review runbook and handoff cheatsheet
summary: Lightweight facilitator-focused runbook for 45-60 minute client review meetings plus an immediate handoff checklist to drive renewals and implementation follow-ups. Emphasizes quick prep, a repeatable agenda, facilitator prompts, and a terse renewal readiness scorecard.
content:
PURPOSE
This doc is a facilitator-oriented runbook intended for Customer Success Managers running mid-to-large account client reviews (quarterly cadence or ad-hoc renewal readiness sessions). It bundles: a short meeting agenda optimized for 45-60 minutes, verbatim facilitation prompts to keep conversations outcome-driven, a pre-meeting prep checklist with owners, and a post-meeting handoff checklist to Sales/Implementation/Support.

SCOPE & AUDIENCE
- Audience: CSMs, AE (optional), Solutions/Delivery lead, Renewal manager.
- Use when: upcoming renewal in 90-180 days, major product adoption goals, or when escalations exist.
- Not for: one-off tactical support syncs or executive-only renewals (use exec brief template instead).

BEFORE THE MEETING (PREP CHECKLIST, T-minus 7 days -> owners)
1) Data snapshot (owner: CSM)
   - Generate a 90-day usage report: DAU/MAU of key features, top 10 users by activity, token/embedding spend trends.
   - Surface top 3 success stories (customer-cited wins) and top 3 friction points (support tickets or feature gaps).
   - Pull latency/error metrics if they map to customer SLOs.
2) Renewal readiness draft (owner: Renewal manager + CSM)
   - Fill preliminary renewal scorecard (see below) and a recommended ask (expand, renew same, reduce scope).
3) Invite list & roles (owner: CSM)
   - Confirm stakeholders: Product owner, Engineering contact (if technical), Procurement/Budget owner. Add AE if contractual discussion likely.
4) Slides & artifacts (owner: CSM)
   - 6-slide deck: 1) goals + attendees, 2) health snapshot, 3) wins + usage, 4) gaps/risks, 5) recommended next steps (renewal ask), 6) decisions & action owners.
   - Attach support ticket summary, adoption runbook, and any open PRs/feature requests.
5) Pre-read & 24H reminder (owner: CSM)
   - Send 1-paragraph pre-read: objectives, top 2 agenda items, ask of attendees (approve renewal recommendation; agree on pilot/POC scope).

MEETING AGENDA (45-60 min, timeboxed)
- 0:00–0:05 — Welcome & objectives (Facilitator)
  - Script: "Thanks everyone for joining. Quick go-round of names/roles. Today we have two goals: ensure alignment on outcomes you need from Redwood for the next period, and agree the next-best commercial/technical steps to get there. Is anyone looking to add an objective?"
- 0:05–0:12 — Customer priorities & business context (Customer lead)
  - Prompt: ask customer to restate top 2 business outcomes for the period and any shifts in strategy.
- 0:12–0:25 — Health snapshot + adoption narrative (Facilitator + CSM)
  - Present 90-day metrics: usage trends, latency/SLOs, cost-per-unit movement. Use one slide per metric.
  - Script: "Here are three signals we read: what looks right from your perspective? Anything surprising?"
- 0:25–0:35 — Wins, blockers, and risk triage (Open discussion)
  - Facilitation prompts: "Which wins drove the most business value? Which blockers are materially blocking outcomes? If we had to prioritize one blocker to fix in the next 30 days, what would it be?"
- 0:35–0:45 — Renewal/next-phase proposal (Facilitator + Renewal manager / AE)
  - Present recommendation: renewal term, licensing model (hosted/dedicated/private), any discounts or pilots.
  - Script: "Given what we heard, our recommended next step is X. Does that align with your procurement timeline and budget?"
- 0:45–0:55 — Decision & action alignment (Facilitator)
  - Capture decisions in real-time (who, what, when). If final approval can’t happen, agree on next meeting and who will own approvals.
- 0:55–0:60 — Wrap & quick pulse (Facilitator)
  - One-line pulse check: "On a 1–10 scale, how confident are you that this plan will deliver your outcomes?"

FACILITATION NOTES & VERBATIM PROMPTS
- When conversation drifts to tactical: "This is valuable — can we park that in an action item and focus for the next 6 minutes on the outcome-level decisions we need to make today?"
- If stakeholders disagree: "Let’s restate each view in one sentence, then pick the decision metric (cost, time-to-value, security) to break the tie."
- For procurement delays: "What is the critical blocker for procurement? Is it legal terms, budget window, or valuation? Who owns moving that forward?"
- To secure commitment: "If we agree to X today, who will sign off and when?"

RENEWAL READINESS SCORECARD (one-line fields — fill quickly pre-meeting)
- Strategic alignment: High/Medium/Low
- Usage sufficiency: High/Medium/Low (based on % of core features used)
- Technical risk: High/Medium/Low (open P1/P2 tickets, infra concerns)
- Financial readiness: On-track/At-risk (procurement dates, budget cycles)
- Exec sponsorship: Present/Absent/Weak
- Recommended ask: Expand/Same/Rollback + short rationale
- Confidence (CSM): 1-10

RISK ESCALATION & FALLBACKS
- If technical blocker rated High: book a technical deep-dive with Platform Engineering within 3 business days. Owner: Solutions Eng.
- If procurement is behind: AE to propose interim bridge terms (30d extension, pilot acceptance criteria). Owner: AE.
- If exec sponsorship absent: schedule a 20-minute exec briefing with an internal partner; prepare 3 ROI slides. Owner: CSM + AE.

POST-MEETING HANDOFF CHECKLIST (T+0–T+3 days)
1) Notes & decisions (owner: Facilitator/CSM) — update the shared doc and tag action owners (due dates).
2) Renewal ask & quote (owner: AE/Renewal manager) — send a single-line commercial summary and draft term sheet within 48 hours.
3) Technical tickets (owner: Solutions Eng) — create scoped tickets for agreed fixes; estimate time and ETA.
4) Pilot/POC kickoff (if agreed) — attach success criteria and measurement plan; schedule first checkpoint within 14 days.
5) Exec briefing (if required) — deliver 3-slide ROI pack to customer execs within 7 days.

POST-MEETING TEMPLATE: FOLLOW-UP EMAIL (send within 24 hours)
Subject: Recap + decisions from today’s client review — [Customer Name]
Body (one-paragraph summary + bullets):
- Quick recap of objectives and one-sentence outcome.
- 3 bullets: decisions (who/what/when)
- 2 bullets: immediate next steps and owner(s) with dates
- Attach: slide deck, scorecard snapshot, tickets list, proposed quote link

COMMON PITFALLS (notes from past playbooks)
- Over-investing time in low-opportunity customers. Use the scorecard pre-meeting to gate depth of review.
- Leaving procurement as an open-ended action — always set a specific date and owner.
- Not surfacing technical debt: small infra issues compound into renewal risk. Surface them early and quantify impact.

EXPERIMENT/BETA TACTICS (try these for at-risk renewals)
- 30-day money-back pilot clause: deployable for customers who are near-term at-risk but high-strategic value.
- Outcome-based milestone payments: 40% on kickoff, 60% on validated outcomes (requires legal coordination).

QUICK REFERENCE: SLIDES + DOCS TO ATTACH
- Usage snapshot (CSV export)
- Support ticket summary (last 90d)
- Renewal scorecard (single-page)
- Proposed term sheet (one-pager)

OPEN QUESTIONS / NOTES TO SELF
- Can we create an automated pre-meeting pack (usage + tickets + scorecard) to reduce prep time by 60%? (owner: ops)
- Try a 30-minute condensed format for small customers; measure decision velocity.
- Ask Legal if outcome-based clauses can be templatized.

REVISION HISTORY
- 2025-11-04: initial draft (Aisha)
- 2026-01-12: added renewal scorecard + fallbacks (Priya)
- 2026-03-10: updated follow-up templates and experiment tactics (Liam)

If you use this for an upcoming review and want a facilitator run-through or a 1:1 rehearsal, ping me in #cs-qbr or schedule a 30-min dry run (Aisha).
